assignments.title: BÀI THI KHẢO THÍ TIẾNG ANH - CHỦ ĐỀ: LIFE
assignments.content: Hue Citadel is one of the most famous (7) ________ in Vietnam. There are many historical citadels in Vietnam, but now only a few remain preserved. A citadel is similar (8) ________ a royal castle. Citadels were homes for Kings and Queens. Hue Citadel was the home of many Kings and (9) ________ families. It was built in the 19th century and was mainly constructed from wood and bricks. The walls were made from strong stone bricks to keep the royal family safe. It doesn't have (10) ________ dungeons, but there is an impressive moat surrounding it. Today, architects use (11) ________ techniques to protect historical heritage while maintaining structural integrity. Every year, thousands of international visitors (12) ________ the Citadel and admire its majestic royal palaces.
assignments.instructions: Đề thi gồm các câu hỏi trắc nghiệm và câu sắp xếp từ theo mẫu khảo thí.

assignments.title: Academic Reading: Biophilic Design in Workplace Environments
assignments.content: Biophilic design seeks to connect building occupants more closely to nature. Incorporating natural lighting, vegetation, and natural materials creates a restorative and invigorating environment. Studies show a 15% increase in worker productivity and a significant reduction in reported stress levels when biophilic elements are integrated into office architecture.
assignments.instructions: Hoàn thành 3 câu hỏi trắc nghiệm bên dưới (hệ thống tự chấm tối đa 5.0 điểm), và viết 01 câu chủ đề tóm tắt (Topic Sentence) để Chuyên gia chấm tự luận (tối đa 5.0 điểm).

submissions.assignment_title: Academic Reading: Biophilic Design in Workplace Environments
Writing Essay: Sustainable Architecture & Green Buildings
submissions.content: In contemporary architectural discourse, sustainable development has shifted from a novel trend to an imperative mandate. Utilizing renewable materials like cross-laminated timber drastically curtails the embodied carbon footprint. Furthermore, passive solar heating and rainwater harvesting systems reduce operational emissions. Consequently, sustainable buildings not only mitigate environmental degradation but also foster healthier living habitats for future generations.
submissions.feedback: Bài viết rất mạch lạc, sử dụng từ vựng chuyên ngành kiến trúc xuất sắc (cross-laminated timber, embodied carbon, operational emissions). Ngữ pháp đa dạng và cấu trúc luận điểm thuyết phục.
